# Trubbo

> Trubbo is a fun quiz for iPhone, for road trips and parties. It reads every question aloud and you answer out loud. In English, Slovak and Czech.

Trubbo reads each question aloud and the player answers in their own words; the app checks the answer and tells the story behind it. People play it alone or together: on road trips, at parties, at the cabin, with family.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762482437

## Pricing

- Free: 30 questions a month
- €4.99 a month: Trubbo Plus, 1,000 questions a month
- €8.99: custom pack of 30 questions, paid once
